purpose: Faixas de busca para o experimento G040_E1 (física legado SCS-CN + SCS UH com estados/fronteiras observados), derivadas exclusivamente do inventário documentado das 145 sub-bacias e do contrato de roteamento multi-evento. Não são parâmetros promovidos.

event2_calibrated_may2024.interpretation: wet-event calibration reference; not transferable automatically

search_policy.stage_1: fit routing first where observed upstream/downstream discharge pairs exist, respecting routing_search_contract_latest.json
search_policy.stage_2: fit incremental rainfall-runoff parameters against multiple downstream checkpoints, not a single outlet
search_policy.stage_3: joint refinement with volume, peak, timing, rise and recession metrics
search_policy.parameters_may_be_shared_initially: regional/shared parameter multipliers may be tested to reduce identifiability, then interval-specific departures only when evidence supports them
forbidden: use event2 calibrated CN/lag as fixed current values
visual stage shift presented as assimilation
zero-fill missing rainfall or tributary discharge

next_step: build scenario-specific HEC-HMS G040_E1 project and calibration runner after merged rainfall forcing passes
